ayo-berayun-momo.summaryId: Kisah Siamang Penakut yang Berani Berayun Demi Sahabat
ayo-berayun-momo.summaryEn: A Touching Tale of Overcoming Fear Through Friendship
ayo-berayun-momo.moralId: Pesan moral cerita ini: Keberanian Tumbuh Saat Kita Peduli dan Menolong Sesama!. Mari kita selalu siap menolong sesama dengan kasih sayang! Saat kita peduli pada teman, rasa berani akan tumbuh dengan indah di dalam hati kita.
ayo-berayun-momo.moralEn: The moral of the story: True Courage Blooms When We Care and Help Others!. Let us always be ready to help others with kindness! When we care for our friends, courage grows naturally inside our hearts.
scenesId: Momo adalah seekor siamang Sumatra. Namun, ia tidak pernah mau berayun.
Momo sering mengeluh. Mengapa mereka tinggal di pohon yang tinggi?
Siamang tinggal di pedalaman hutan. Di sana ada banyak hewan buas berkeliaran. Tinggal di atas pohon membuat siamang aman.
Momo tidak berani berayun. Ia pernah hampir terjatuh. Momo takut itu akan terulang lagi.
Teman-teman mengajak Momo bermain. Pohon ara di pinggir hutan sedang berbuah. Mereka akan ke sana untuk memetiknya.
Uh, Momo langsung menelan ludah. Ia sangat suka buah ara. Namun, Momo tidak berani meninggalkan pohonnya.
Momo memilih tidak ikut. Ia memetik daun muda saja di sekitarnya.
Daun-daunan juga rasanya enak meskipun tidak seenak buah ara.
Siang itu hutan terasa sepi. Keluarga dan teman-temannya sudah pergi. Momo tinggal sendiri.
Cuit, cuit. Momo tersentak. Suara apa itu? Ia mengintip ke bawah.
Seekor anak burung mencicit. Ia terjatuh dari sarangnya di atas pohon. Momo terbelalak.
Cuit, cuit! Induk burung ribut mencicit. Ya, ampun, seekor ular datang mendekat. Ia mengincar anak burung itu.
Momo segera berteriak panik. Kantung tenggorokannya membulat besar. Jeritannya melengking kencang. Ia harus meminta bantuan.
Kantung tenggorokan Momo membulat dan mengempis. Ini adalah cara siamang bersuara nyaring untuk berkomunikasi satu dengan yang lain.
Sayangnya, tidak ada yang kunjung datang. Keluarga dan teman-temannya pasti sibuk memetik buah ara di tepi hutan.
Apa yang harus Momo lakukan? Momo mondar-mandir kebingungan. Ular itu makin mendekat. Kasihan anak burung itu.
Momo memegang dahan dengan ragu. Haruskah ia berayun dan melompat? Uh, tetapi ia masih takut.
Eh, mendadak Momo sudah menggelantung. Harus bagaimana sekarang? Tempat anak burung terjatuh cukup jauh.
Ayo, melompat! Ular itu makin mendekat! Momo melupakan rasa takutnya. Berayun, Momo terus berayun. Wing, wing.
Hap. Momo mendarat di seberang pohon. Ia mencengkeram batangnya kuat-kuat.
Momo meraih anak burung. Kemudian, ia memanjat cepat. Ia memanjat terus menuju sarang burung di atas pohon.
Cuit, cuit. Anak burung sudah kembali ke sarangnya. Momo berseru senang. Ia berani berayun lagi!
scenesEn: Momo is a Sumatran siamang. But he never, ever wants to swing.
Momo often complains. Why do they have to live high up in the trees?
Siamangs live deep in the dense forest where many wild beasts roam. Living high in the trees keeps them safe.
Momo does not dare to swing. He once slipped and almost fell. Momo is terrified it might happen again.
His friends invite Momo to play. The fig tree at the edge of the forest is fruiting, and they are going to harvest the sweet figs.
Uh, Momo's mouth immediately waters. He loves sweet figs! But Momo does not dare to leave his tree.
Momo chooses to stay behind. He simply plucks tender young leaves around him instead.
The leaves taste quite nice too, even though they are not as sweet as fresh figs.
That afternoon, the forest feels quiet and still. His family and friends have gone, leaving Momo all by himself.
Chirp, chirp! Momo is startled. What could that sound be? He peers down below the canopy.
A helpless baby bird is crying. It has tumbled from its nest high in the tree! Momo's eyes widen with alarm.
Chirp, chirp! The mother bird flutters frantically. Oh no, a sneaky snake is slithering near, targeting the little chick!
Momo shouts out in sheer panic. His throat sac expands round and huge. His shrieks ring out loud through the jungle, desperately calling for help.
Momo's throat sac swells and deflates. This is the special way siamangs make booming sounds to talk across long distances.
Sadly, nobody comes to help. His family and friends must be busy enjoying sweet figs far away at the forest border.
What should Momo do? Momo paces back and forth, deeply worried. The snake creeps closer and closer. Poor little bird!
Momo grasps the branch with trembling hands. Should he dare to swing and leap across? Oh, but he is still so scared!
Whoa, suddenly Momo is already dangling in midair! What now? The spot where the chick fell is quite far away.
Come on, leap! The snake is right there! Momo forgets all of his fears. Swinging, Momo swings onward and forward! Whoosh, whoosh!
Hap! Momo lands safely on the tree across the gap. He holds on to the trunk tightly with all his strength.
Momo gently scoops up the baby bird. Then, he scurries swiftly up the branches, climbing straight toward the high nest.
Chirp, chirp! The baby bird is safely home in its nest. Momo cheers with immense joy. He has found the courage to swing again!

bulan-dan-topi-biru.summaryId: Kisah Menenangkan Menemukan Senyuman di Bawah Cahaya Bulan
bulan-dan-topi-biru.summaryEn: A Comforting Bedtime Tale of Friendship Under the Stars
bulan-dan-topi-biru.moralId: Nah teman-teman, pesan moral dari cerita ini adalah: saat kita kehilangan barang kesayangan, jangan berlarut-larut dalam kesedihan ya! Belajarlah ikhlas dan tetap tersenyum, karena kasih sayang keluarga akan selalu menghadirkan kebahagiaan baru yang lebih indah!
bulan-dan-topi-biru.moralEn: The moral of the story: when we lose something dear to us, don't let sadness stay in your heart! When you smile and let go, the love of family will always bring new joy and brighter days!
scenesId: Suatu sore yang cerah, kami sekeluarga pergi bertualang ke pekan raya desa yang sangat ramai dan meriah!
Papa membelikan Kak Chintu kacamata keren. Ibu membelikanku sebuah topi biru yang indah, dan adik kecil mendapatkan permen gula-gula yang manis!
Dalam perjalanan pulang, tiba-tiba angin kencang berhembus wuuussshh! Angin itu meniup topi biruku hingga melayang tinggi ke udara!
Aduh gawat! Topi biruku yang cantik tersangkut tinggi di dahan pohon beringin tua, dan tidak bisa dijangkau sama sekali!
Aku menangis tersedu-sedu karena sedih sekali kehilangan topi baruku. Malam itu, aku bahkan tidak mau makan malam.
Larut malam di kamarku, bulan purnama yang bulat dan terang mulai terbit di langit. Sang Bulan melihat topi biruku yang tersangkut di atas pohon tua.
Lihatlah! Sang Bulan perlahan mencoba memakai topi biruku di kepalanya. Sang Bulan tersenyum lebar dan bahagia sekali, hingga aku pun ikut tersenyum riang!
Keesokan harinya sepulang sekolah, Ibu menyambutku dengan senyuman hangat dan sebuah kotak kado. Topi merah baru kiriman dari sang Bulan untukku!
Malam itu, sang Bulan mengenakan topi birunya, dan aku mengenakan topi merah baruku. Kami berdua tersenyum riang gembira di bawah langit malam yang bertabur bintang!
scenesEn: One sunny afternoon, all of us went on an exciting family trip to the lively village fair!
Papa bought Chintu fancy glasses. Mother bought me a bright, beautiful blue cap, and our sweet baby got delicious sugar candy!
On our way home, a very strong wind came rushing by—whoooosh! It blew my shiny new cap right off my head and into the sky!
Oh dear! My wonderful blue cap got stuck high up on a branch of the old Pipal tree, far out of reach!
I cried so much because I was heartbroken over my lost cap. That night, I was too sad to even eat my dinner.
Late that night, the big round moon came up into the quiet sky. It looked down gently at my blue cap resting in the old tree branches.
Look! The moon gently tried on my cap. The moon smiled so brightly and happily, that I couldn't help but smile too!
After school the next day, Mother greeted me with a warm hug and a lovely surprise: a shiny, brand-new red cap from the moon!
That night, the moon wore its blue cap, and I proudly wore my new red cap. We both smiled happily under the sparkling starry sky!

dengarkan-tubuhku.summaryId: Kisah Edukatif Mengenal Detak Jantung dan Nafas Diri Sendiri
dengarkan-tubuhku.summaryEn: A Mindful Bedtime Journey of Hearing Our Own Heart and Breath
dengarkan-tubuhku.moralId: Pesan moral cerita ini: Mari Dengarkan dan Sayangi Tubuh Kita!. Tubuh kita punya banyak cara manis untuk menyapa! Mari dengarkan saat tubuh butuh istirahat, makanan sehat, dan bergerak dengan gembira setiap hari.
dengarkan-tubuhku.moralEn: The moral of the story: Let's Listen to and Love Our Body!. Our body speaks to us in sweet little ways! Let's listen when our body needs rest, healthy food, and joyful movement every single day.
scenesId: Hari ini aku tidak pergi ke sekolah. Hari ini adalah hari libur yang tenang!
Hari ini aku juga tidak bisa menonton televisi, karena listrik di rumah sedang padam. Lalu, apa yang bisa kulakukan?
Aha! Hari ini aku akan mendengarkan suara tubuhku sendiri!
Pertama, aku harus tenang dan diam. Tarik nafas perlahan... hembuskan... sssss... suara nafasku terdengar jelas!
Dan sekarang aku bisa mendengar detak jantungku! Deg-dug, deg-dug, deg-dug! Saat aku melompat dua puluh kali, jantungku berdetak semakin kencang!
Ketika meletakkan jari di pergelangan tangan, denyut nadiku terasa berdetak. Lalu aku mendengar suara tawaku sendiri: Hahahaha!
Plok-plok-plok! Suara tepuk tanganku nyaring sekali! Tapi yang paling lucu... kruk-kruk-kruk! Perutku berbunyi minta makan!
Hidungku mencium wangi masakan kue lezat buatan Ibu di dapur. Menyenangkan sekali bisa mendengarkan tubuhku sendiri hari ini!
scenesEn: Today I am not going to school. It is a holiday!
Today I am not going to watch TV. There is no electricity anyway. What am I going to do?
Today I am going to listen to my body!
First, I have to be quiet. Very quiet. So that I can listen to my own body. Yes, now I can hear my breath. In and out.
And now I can hear my heart beating! Doodom, doodoom, dooodooom! By jumping up and down twenty times, my heart beats faster!
If I put my fingers on my wrist, I can feel my pulse! And I can hear myself laughing happily: Hahahaha!
Clap-clap-clap! My hands sound so clear! And most of all, I can hear my stomach rumbling: Feed me, feed me!
My nose can smell sweet treats frying in mother's kitchen. It is so fun listening to my body today!

di-bawah-tempat-tidurku.id: Ada Harimau di Bawah Tempat Tidurku!
di-bawah-tempat-tidurku.summaryId: Kisah Jenaka Menghadapi Rasa Takut di Tengah Malam
di-bawah-tempat-tidurku.summaryEn: A Fun Bedtime Tale of Conquering Nighttime Shadows
di-bawah-tempat-tidurku.moralId: Pesan moral cerita ini: Keberanian Membawa Ketenangan dan Kedamaian!. Mari kita selalu bersikap tenang dan berani. Saat melihat sesuatu yang asing di dalam gelap, kita bisa menyalakan lampu dan bertanya kepada orang tua dengan lembut. Semua akan terasa tenang dan aman!
di-bawah-tempat-tidurku.moralEn: The moral of the story: Embracing Courage and Calmness at Bedtime!. Let's stay calm and brave whenever something looks unfamiliar in the dark. Turning on the light and talking with our parents helps us see clearly and feel safe!
scenesId: Tengah malam, aku terbangun karena merasa haus sekali. Aku ingin mengambil segelas air minum. Lalu aku mulai mencari sandal rumahku di bawah kolong tempat tidur.
Astaga! Ya ampun! Ada seekor harimau belang bersembunyi tepat di bawah tempat tidurku!
Aduh, sekarang apa yang harus kulakukan? Jantungku berdegup sangat kencang!
Haruskah aku berteriak memanggil Ibu? Tapi bagaimana jika harimau itu mendadak mengaum keras?
Haruskah aku menarik selimut dan tidur lagi? Tapi rasa kantukku sudah hilang sama sekali!
Tiba-tiba, cling! Lampu kamar menyala terang. Ibu tampak berdiri tersenyum lembut di depan pintu.
'Ada apa, sayangku? Apakah tadi kamu memanggil Ibu?' tanya Ibu sambil menghampiriku.
Dengan gemetar aku menunjuk ke kolong ranjang. Ibu membungkuk santai dan menarik sang harimau keluar!
Wah, ternyata ini sama sekali bukan harimau! Ini hanyalah baju hangat tebal belang kuning hitam kesayanganku. Kancing bajunya berkilau mirip mata harimau!
Hahaha! Ternyata aku cuma takut pada bayanganku sendiri! Ibu lalu membawakanku segelas air segar.
Sekarang aku bisa tidur nyenyak kembali. Dan bermimpi bertualang bersama harimau ramah di dalam hutan!
scenesEn: I wake up at night feeling thirsty. I want to get some water. I start looking for my slippers under the bed.
Oh my God! There is a tiger under my bed.
Now what should I do?
Should I call Ma? What if the tiger roars?
Should I just go back to sleep? But I am not sleepy any more.
Then someone turns on the light. Ma is standing at the door.
"What happened dear? Did you call me?" asks Ma.
I point towards the tiger. Ma bends and pulls the tiger out from under the bed!
Hey, this is no tiger. This is my thick yellow and black sweater. Its buttons shine like a tiger's eyes.
I got scared for nothing! Ma gets me some water.
Now I will sleep. And dream about real tigers in a jungle!

edu-budi-fermentasi-nusantara.id: Yuk, Mengenal Makanan Hasil Fermentasi Khas Indonesia
edu-budi-fermentasi-nusantara.summaryId: Mandai? Pakasam? Dadih? Itu bukan nama pohon lho, melainkan makanan lezat hasil fermentasi khas Indonesia bersama tempe!
edu-budi-fermentasi-nusantara.summaryEn: Mandai? Pakasam? Dadih? Those aren't fruit trees! Along with tempe, they are Indonesia's traditional fermented foods.
edu-budi-fermentasi-nusantara.moralId: Cegah Boros Pangan, Perut Pun Sehat! Berkat fermentasi tradisional Indonesia, makanan awet bergizi, lezat, dan tidak mudah terbuang!
edu-budi-fermentasi-nusantara.moralEn: Zero Food Waste, Happy Healthy Tummy! Thanks to Indonesian fermentation wisdom, foods stay nutritious longer and never go to waste!
scenesId: Mandai? Pakasam? Dadih? Itu bukan nama pohon lho, melainkan makanan lezat hasil fermentasi khas Indonesia bersama tempe!
Bahannya beragam! Tempe dari kedelai, dadih dari susu kerbau dalam bambu, mandai dari kulit cempedak, dan pakasam dari ikan.
Di negeri tropis yang panas, susu kerbau dan ikan segar mudah sekali basi jika disimpan biasa.
Untungnya ada pasukan mikroba baik seperti ragi dan bakteri asam laktat! Mereka melindungi makanan secara alami.
Hasilnya kaya probiotik menyehatkan perut dan menambah pengetahuan kita akan kuliner Nusantara!
scenesEn: Mandai? Pakasam? Dadih? Those aren't fruit trees! Along with tempe, they are Indonesia's traditional fermented foods.
The ingredients amaze everyone! Soybeans make tempe, buffalo milk makes bamboo dadih, cempedak skin makes mandai, and river fish makes pakasam.
In warm tropical weather, fresh buffalo milk and fish used to spoil quickly if left stored plainly.
Thankfully, friendly microbes like ragi and lactic bacteria help! They preserve food naturally and safely.
They boost gut-friendly probiotics and celebrate Indonesia's wonderful culinary heritage!

edu-budi-papang-teripang.en: Papang the Sea Cucumber and the Coral Reef
edu-budi-papang-teripang.summaryId: Lihat terumbu karang indah ini! Namanya Jakang, hewan laut rumah seperempat ikan di samudera.
edu-budi-papang-teripang.summaryEn: See this colorful coral reef? His name is Jakang, a living sea animal home to one quarter of ocean fish.
edu-budi-papang-teripang.moralId: Kecil Tapi Penjaga Samudera! Walau bertubuh kecil seperti Papang teripang, kebaikan kita tetap bisa menjaga laut dan terumbu karang!
edu-budi-papang-teripang.moralEn: Small Body, Giant Ocean Hero! Even a small creature like Papang can heal coral reefs and protect our oceans!
scenesId: Lihat terumbu karang indah ini! Namanya Jakang, hewan laut rumah seperempat ikan di samudera.
Saat manusia mengambil dan merusak karang, tubuh Jakang memutih retak! Ikan-ikan kecil pun sedih kehilangan rumah.
Jangan sedih! Datang sahabatnya, Papang si teripang lucu. Seperti penyedot debu laut, Papang menyaring empat puluh lima kilogram pasir tiap tahun!
Ajaibnya, pasir bersih dan kalsium Papang menyuburkan dasar laut! Jakang tumbuh cerah lagi, ikan-ikan kecil pun pulang.
Berkat kerja sama Papang, Jakang, dan ikan kecil, lautan kembali bersih dan sehat bagi semua makhluk.
scenesEn: See this colorful coral reef? His name is Jakang, a living sea animal home to one quarter of ocean fish.
When humans break and harvest reefs, Jakang turns pale and cracked! Tiny fish feel scared without a home.
Don't worry! Here comes his friend, Papang the cute sea cucumber. Like an ocean vacuum, he filters forty-five kilograms of sand every year!
Amazingly, clean sand and calcium nourish the seabed! Bright coral buds bloom again, and happy little fish swim home.
Thanks to teamwork from Papang, Jakang, and tiny fish, the ocean becomes clean and healthy for everyone.

edu-curiosity-awan-jatuh.id: Misteri Sains: Awan 500 Ton Kenapa Tidak Jatuh?
edu-curiosity-awan-jatuh.en: Science Mystery: Why Doesn't a 500-Ton Cloud Fall to Earth?
edu-curiosity-awan-jatuh.summaryId: Itu setara 100 gajah dewasa melayang di atas kepalamu! Tapi kenapa ia tidak langsung jatuh menimpa bumi?
edu-curiosity-awan-jatuh.summaryEn: That is equal to 100 adult elephants floating right above you! But why doesn't it crash into the ground?
edu-curiosity-awan-jatuh.moralId: Hal Kecil yang Bersatu Menjadi Luar Biasa! Satu tetes air mungkin tak terasa, tapi saat miliaran butir bersatu, mereka membentuk awan megah yang menaungi bumi!
edu-curiosity-awan-jatuh.moralEn: Tiny Things United Become Extraordinary! A single water droplet seems fragile, but billions united together create magnificent clouds that shelter the earth!
scenesId: Itu setara 100 gajah dewasa melayang di atas kepalamu! Tapi kenapa ia tidak langsung jatuh menimpa bumi?
Rahasianya, awan bukan satu benda padat! Ia terdiri dari miliaran tetesan air mikro yang lebarnya cuma 0,01 milimeter!
Tiap butir air turun sangat lambat, cuma 1 cm per detik, dan langsung terdorong naik lagi oleh arus udara hangat bumi!
scenesEn: That is equal to 100 adult elephants floating right above you! But why doesn't it crash into the ground?
The secret is, a cloud isn't solid! It's made of billions of microscopic water droplets just 0.01 millimeters wide!
Each tiny droplet drifts down at only 1 cm per second, easily pushed back up by warm rising air currents!

edu-fabel-kancil-buaya.id: Fabel Nusantara: Si Kancil & Jembatan Buaya
edu-fabel-kancil-buaya.en: Indonesian Fable: The Clever Mousedeer & The Crocodile Bridge
edu-fabel-kancil-buaya.summaryId: Di seberang sungai ada pohon apel merah yang manis, tapi airnya deras dan dijaga buaya raksasa!
edu-fabel-kancil-buaya.summaryEn: Across the river grows a sweet red apple tree, but the water is fast and guarded by giant crocodiles!
edu-fabel-kancil-buaya.moralId: Akal Cerdik Mengalahkan Otot Raksasa! Tetap tenang, berpikir cerdik, dan pantang menyerah saat menghadapi masalah besar!
edu-fabel-kancil-buaya.moralEn: Clever Wit Beats Giant Muscle! Stay calm, think smart, and never give up when facing a giant problem!
scenesId: Di seberang sungai ada pohon apel merah yang manis, tapi airnya deras dan dijaga buaya raksasa!
Saat hewan lain panik ketakutan, otak Kancil justru tenang mencari seratus ide pintar dalam sekejap!
Kancil berseru membawa undangan makan siang dari Raja Hutan, lalu meminta semua buaya berbaris rapi untuk dihitung!
Hap! Satu, dua, tiga! Kancil melompati punggung buaya satu per satu sambil berhitung sampai mendarat selamat di seberang!
Jadi kuncinya adalah tetap tenang, berpikir cerdik, dan pantang menyerah saat menghadapi masalah besar!
scenesEn: Across the river grows a sweet red apple tree, but the water is fast and guarded by giant crocodiles!
While other animals panic in fear, Mousedeer stays calm and sparks a hundred smart ideas in a flash!
Mousedeer announces a royal feast invitation from the Jungle King, asking all crocodiles to line up neatly to be counted!
Hop! One, two, three! Mousedeer leaps across the crocodiles one by one while counting until he lands safely across!
So the key is staying calm, thinking smart, and never giving up when facing a giant problem!

edu-hybrid-test-no-image.en: The Mousedeer and Magic Star (Edu-Motion Host Edition)

gara-gara-kucing.summaryId: Cerita Bergambar Penuh Tawa & Pesan Moral
gara-gara-kucing.summaryEn: A Hilarious Bedtime Tale for Kids
scenesId: Mengapa kamu tidak mengerjakan tugas? Bu, ini semua gara-gara kucing!
Kalau kucing itu tidak terjebak di atas pohon, saya tidak akan mengambil tangga untuk membantunya.
Kalau tidak menaiki tangga itu, saya tidak akan tahu tangga perlu diperbaiki. Kalau tidak memperbaiki tangga, saya tidak akan membangunkan adik bayi.
Kalau adik bayi tidak terbangun, ibu saya tidak akan terburu-buru meninggalkan dapur. Kalau ibu tidak meninggalkan dapur, monyet tidak akan masuk.
Kalau monyet tidak masuk, ia tidak akan menghabiskan semua makanan. Kalau makanan tidak habis dimakan monyet, bapak tidak akan membeli roti dan kari ayam di pasar.
Kalau bapak tidak membeli roti di pasar, anjing itu tidak akan mengikuti bapak ke rumah.
Kalau anjing itu tidak mengikuti bapak ke rumah, ia tidak akan memakan tugas sekolah saya.
Oalah, jadi tugas sekolahmu dimakan anjing?
Iya, Bu. Itu semua gara-gara kucing!
scenesEn: Why haven't you done your homework? Ma'am, it's all the cat's fault!
If the cat hadn't climbed up the tree, I wouldn't have gone to fetch the ladder.
If I hadn't climbed the ladder, I wouldn't have known it was broken. If I hadn't mended the ladder, I wouldn't have woken the baby.
If the baby hadn't woken up, my mother wouldn't have run out of the kitchen. If mother hadn't left the kitchen, the monkey wouldn't have got in.
If the monkey hadn't got in, it wouldn't have eaten all the food. If it hadn't eaten all the food, my father wouldn't have gone to buy bread and chicken curry.
If father hadn't bought bread and curry, the dog wouldn't have followed him home.
If the dog hadn't followed him home, it wouldn't have eaten my homework!
So your homework was eaten by a dog?!
Yes, ma'am! It was all the cat's fault!

hari-cukur-rambut.summaryId: Kisah Jenaka Menghadapi Masalah dengan Penuh Tawa
hari-cukur-rambut.summaryEn: A Hilarious Bedtime Tale of Unexpected Solutions
hari-cukur-rambut.moralId: Pesan moral cerita ini: Jangan pernah berputus asa saat menghadapi kesulitan! Terkadang hal yang paling tidak kita duga justru membawa jalan keluar terbaik dengan penuh tawa dan kebahagiaan!
hari-cukur-rambut.moralEn: The moral of the story: Never give up when things don't go your way! Sometimes, life's biggest worries solve themselves in unexpected ways that bring us pure joy and laughter!
scenesId: Hari ini adalah Hari Cukur Rambut Tahunan bagi Sringeri Srinivas. Rambutnya sudah sangat panjang dan lebat. Seperti biasa, ia berangkat menuju tukang cukur desa.
Tetapi tukang cukur berkata, "Aduh, hari ini aku tidak punya waktu untuk memotong rambut sepanjang itu!"
Dengan hati sedih, Sringeri Srinivas pulang ke rumah untuk meminta tolong istrinya. Tetapi sang istri berkata, "Aduh, hari ini aku sibuk memasak, tidak sempat memotong rambut sepanjang itu!"
Mulai agak kesal, Sringeri Srinivas pergi menemui sahabatnya, si penjahit. Tetapi tukang jahit berkata, "Aduh, jahitanku menumpuk! Hari ini aku tidak punya waktu memotong rambut sepanjang itu!"

Sekarang mulai cemas, Sringeri Srinivas pergi menemui sahabatnya yang lain, si tukang kayu. Tetapi tukang kayu berkata, "Aduh, kayuku masih banyak! Hari ini aku tidak punya waktu memotong rambut sepanjang itu!"
Kasihan sekali Sringeri Srinivas. Rasanya tidak ada satu pun orang yang mau memotong rambutnya di Hari Cukur Rambut ini. Sambil meneteskan air mata, ia berjalan sendirian melewati hutan desa.
Ia duduk di dekat sebuah gua batu dan menangis tersedu-sedu: "Hari sudah hampir sore... Bagaimana aku bisa menepati janjiku untuk potong rambut? Ya Tuhan, tolonglah aku!"

Seekor harimau yang sedang tidur nyenyak di dalam gua merasa sangat terganggu oleh suara tangisan itu. Harimau itu keluar sambil mengaum keras, mengayunkan cakar raksasanya ke arah Sringeri Srinivas! Auummm!
Sringeri Srinivas begitu kaget dan ketakutan... Sangat takut, teramat takut, sampai-sampai... PLOP! Seluruh rambut di kepalanya rontok sekaligus!
Sambil memegang kepalanya yang botak licin, Sringeri Srinivas berlari secepat kilat kembali ke desa dengan wajah gembira! Harimau pun kembali tidur dengan tenang.
Sekarang, Sringeri Srinivas tidak perlu potong rambut lagi untuk waktu yang sangat, sangat lama!
scenesEn: It was the Annual Haircut Day for Sringeri Srinivas. Sringeri Srinivas left home as usual to go to the local barber.
But the barber said, "Today, I have no time to cut such long hair!"
Feeling sad, Sringeri Srinivas went back home to ask his wife for help. But his wife said, "Today, I have no time to cut such long hair!"
Feeling a little angry, Sringeri Srinivas went to his friend, the tailor. But the tailor said, "Today, I have no time to cut such long hair!"
Now a little worried, Sringeri Srinivas went to one more friend, the carpenter. But the carpenter said, "Today, I have no time to cut such long hair!"
Poor Sringeri Srinivas. It seemed no one would cut his hair on this Annual Haircut Day. In tears, he walked off by himself past the village forest.
He sat near a cave and cried loudly: "The day is nearly over. How can I keep my promise to cut my hair? Oh God, help me!"
The tiger sleeping peacefully inside the cave was very disturbed by all the noise. He came out, roaring, waving his giant paws at Sringeri Srinivas!
Poor Sringeri Srinivas was so scared, so scared, so scared that... all the hair fell off his head!
Sringeri Srinivas ran all the way back to the village! The tiger went back to sleep.
Now, Sringeri Srinivas will not need a haircut for a very, very long time!

jangan-sekarang.summaryId: Kisah Hangat Tentang Kesabaran dan Kejutan Manis
jangan-sekarang.summaryEn: A Sweet Tale of Patience and a Heartwarming Birthday Surprise
jangan-sekarang.moralId: Pesan moral cerita ini: Belajar Bersabar dengan Hati Ceria!. Mari belajar bersabar dengan hati yang ceria. Ketika kita sabar menunggu dengan gembira, hal-hal indah dan kejutan manis akan menyambut kita!
jangan-sekarang.moralEn: The moral of the story: Learning Patience with a Happy Heart!. Let's learn to be patient with a cheerful heart. When we wait happily, wonderful surprises filled with love await us!
scenesId: Aku bertanya kepada Nenek, 'Nenek, bolehkah aku minta kue manis sekarang?' 'Jangan sekarang sayang, mungkin besok ya.' Tapi aku tidak mau menunggu sampai besok!
Aku bertanya kepada Kakek, 'Kakek, bolehkah aku main keluar bersama teman-teman?' 'Jangan sekarang sayang, nanti setelah tidur siang ya.' Tapi aku tidak mau tidur siang!
Aku bertanya kepada Ibu, 'Ibu, bolehkah aku pakai baju baru yang keren ini?' 'Jangan sekarang sayang, pakailah saat kita pergi nanti.' Tapi aku ingin memakainya sekarang!
Aku bertanya kepada Ayah, 'Ayah, bolehkah aku membuka kotak berpita indah itu?' 'Jangan sekarang, jangan sekarang. Kamu harus menunggu.' Tapi aku sudah tidak sabar lagi!
Kenapa orang dewasa selalu bilang 'Jangan sekarang, jangan sekarang'? Malam itu, aku pergi tidur dengan hati yang sedikit kesal.
Keesokan paginya, aku bangun pagi-pagi sekali dan pergi ke dapur. Nenek tersenyum manis dan berkata, 'Nah, sekarang kamu boleh makan kue-kue manis ini!'
Kakek berkata, 'Sekarang kita main bersama!' Ibu berkata, 'Sekarang pakailah baju barumu!' Dan Ayah memberikan kotak kado sambil tersenyum lebar.
Dan mereka semua berseru serentak: 'SELAMAT ULANG TAHUN!' Wah, ternyata mereka menyiapkan kejutan paling membahagiakan untukku! Aku pun memeluk mereka dengan riang.
scenesEn: I asked Grandma, "May I please have some sweets?" "Not now, sweetheart, maybe tomorrow." But I did not want to wait till tomorrow.
I asked Grandpa, "May I go out to play with my friends?" "Not now, dear. Maybe after your nap?" But I did not want to wait after my nap.
I asked Mom, "May I wear these new clothes?" "Not now, sweetheart, you can wear them when we go out." But I wanted to wear them now.
I asked Dad, "May I open that nice looking box?" "Not now, not now. You must wait." But I did not want to wait any more.
Why do big people always say, 'Not now, not now'? That night, I went to sleep feeling a little grumpy.
The next day, I woke up early and went into the kitchen. Grandma smiled warmly and said, "You can eat these sweets now!"
Grandpa said, "We can play now!" Mom said, "You can wear these clothes now!" And Dad handed over the gift box with a big bright smile.
And they all cheered together: "HAPPY BIRTHDAY!" Wow, they had prepared the happiest surprise just for me! I hugged them all with pure joy.

jas-hujan-merah.summaryId: Dongeng Indah Tentang Kesabaran & Kasih Sayang
jas-hujan-merah.summaryEn: A Heartwarming Bedtime Tale of Patience
scenesId: Pada hari Minggu, orang tua Manu membelikan sebuah jas hujan merah yang indah. Bolehkah aku memakainya sekarang, Bu? tanya Manu. Belum, sayang. Hujan belum turun, jawab Ibu.
Hari Senin sangat cerah. Apakah hari ini akan hujan, Bu? tanya Manu. Tidak Manu, matahari bersinar sangat terang, kata Ibu.
Hari Selasa langit begitu biru. Bu, kapan keinginanku akan terwujud? tanya Manu. Belum hari ini, sayang, senyum Ibu.
Hari Rabu terasa sangat panas. Kenapa tidak hujan juga, Bu? tanya Manu kehausan. Ibu rasa sebentar lagi hujan akan datang, kata Ibu.
Hari Kamis, Manu pergi piknik ke taman. Bagaimana kalau turun hujan, Bu? Tidak, sayang. Hari ini tidak akan hujan, jawab Ibu.
Hari Jumat awan kelabu mulai berkumpul. Bu, apakah hari ini akan hujan? tanya Manu cemas. Mungkin saja, awan gelap mulai terlihat, kata Ibu.
Hari Sabtu dimulai dengan gemuruh petir! GLUDUK-GLUDUK! BRRRUM! Dan hujan lebat pun turun mencurah!
Horeee, hujan turun! Manu berlari keluar menyambut hujan. Tapi Manu... kamu lupa memakai jas hujan merahmu!
scenesEn: On Sunday, Manu's parents got him a shiny red raincoat. Ma, may I wear it now? asked Manu. No, my dear, the rains are not here yet, said Ma.
Monday was bright and sunny. Will it rain today, Ma? asked Manu. No Manu, not today, the sun is shining high, said Ma.
Tuesday had clear blue skies. Ma, when will my wish come true? asked Manu. Not today, my dear, smiled Ma.
Wednesday was hot and humid. Why doesn't it rain, Ma? asked Manu. I think it will rain very soon, said Ma.
On Thursday, Manu went on a picnic. What if it rains, Ma? No, my dear, it will not rain today, replied Ma.
Friday was cloudy and dim. Ma, will it rain today? asked Manu eagerly. It might, there are dark clouds gathering, said Ma.
Saturday began with a giant bang! CRACK-BOOM! RUMBLE! And the rain poured down heavily!
Hooray, it's raining! Manu ran outside dancing in the rain. But Manu... you forgot to wear your red raincoat!

kacamata-nenek.summaryId: Kisah Detektif Cilik Membantu Nenek Tercinta
kacamata-nenek.summaryEn: A Sweet Tale of a Granddaughter's Loving Mystery Search
kacamata-nenek.moralId: Pesan moral cerita ini: Hati Penuh Kasih, Selalu Siap Membantu Nenek. Membantu kakek dan nenek dengan sabar membuat hati kita dipenuhi kehangatan. Setiap pertolongan kecil yang kita berikan membawa senyum bahagia bagi seluruh keluarga!
kacamata-nenek.moralEn: The moral of the story: Little Helping Hands Bring Big Warm Smiles. Helping our grandparents with patience and love fills our home with joy. Even the smallest act of kindness makes our loved ones truly happy!
scenesId: Nenek selalu lupa di mana menaruh kacamatanya. 'Di mana ya kacamata Nenek?' tanyanya bingung. Tanpa kacamata, Nenek tentu tak bisa melihat untuk mencarinya!
Karena itulah Nenek membutuhkanku! Aku menjadi mata Nenek, untuk menemukan kacamata ajaibnya!
Kadang kacamatanya ada di kamar mandi. Kadang di atas kasur. Dan kadang... tepat di atas kepala Nenek sendiri! 'Nenek, kacamatanya ada di kepala!' seruku tertawa.
'Astaga! Lucu sekali Nenek ini. Terima kasih banyak, Richa sayang,' kata Nenek sambil terkekeh. Tapi kali ini, aku benar-benar belum bisa menemukannya.
Aku sudah mencari ke mana-mana. Di kepala Nenek, di kamar mandi, di dalam lemari, sampai di bawah kursi kesayangannya. Hasilnya tetap nihil!
Aku memutuskan menjadi detektif hebat! Aku harus menelusuri apa saja yang dilakukan Nenek sepanjang hari ini untuk menemukan petunjuk.
Nenek bercerita, 'Hari ini Nenek kedatangan tamu, minum banyak teh hangat, dan menghabiskan kue manis buatan Ibumu.'
Kak Raju menambahkan, 'Nenek juga sibuk sekali menulis surat panjang di meja kerjanya tadi siang.'
Ibu berkata, 'Nenek juga mengobrol di telepon dan selesai merajut sweater hangat untuk Raju!' Wah, kini aku punya banyak petunjuk!
Aha! Ketemu! Kacamatanya terselip di bawah telepon, di samping gulungan benang rajut Nenek! Nenek pun tersenyum bahagia dan memelukku erat.
scenesEn: Nani keeps losing her glasses. "Where did I keep them?" she always asks. Without her glasses, she cannot find her glasses.
So she needs me. To be her eyes, to find her own eyes!
Sometimes her spectacles are in the bathroom. Or on her bed. Or on her head. "Nani," I say, "they are on your head!"
"Of course! How silly of me. Thank you, Richa dear," she says with a giggle. This time, though, I cannot find Nani's glasses. Not yet.
I have looked everywhere. In all the usual places. On her head, in the bathroom, inside her cupboard. Nothing. Where could they be?
I decided to be a good detective. I decided to find out what she had done all day.
"I did nothing much today. Except that our neighbour came by, we had many cups of tea, and enjoyed sweet treats together," said Nani.
Raju said, "Nani was very busy today. She wrote an important letter at her study desk."
Amma said, "She spoke on the phone and finished knitting the warm sweater for Raju!" I now had many clues!
Aha! I found them! The spectacles were wrapped in wool, under the phone on her desk! Nani smiled happily and gave me a big warm hug.

pisang-terlalu-banyak.summaryId: Kisah Jenaka Mengubah Masalah Menjadi Manis & Bahagia
pisang-terlalu-banyak.summaryEn: A Hilarious Bedtime Tale of Turning Trouble Into Sweet Joy
pisang-terlalu-banyak.moralId: Nah teman-teman, nilai moral dari cerita ini adalah: saat kita menghadapi kesulitan atau masalah, jangan pernah putus asa! Gunakan akal dan kreativitas kita untuk mencari solusi yang bermanfaat dan membahagiakan semua orang!
pisang-terlalu-banyak.moralEn: The moral of the story: when faced with a difficult challenge, never give up! With creative thinking and sharing, we can turn any problem into a sweet success that brings joy to everyone!
scenesId: Pak Sringeri Srinivas sedang mengalami hari yang aneh. Panen pisang di kebunnya melimpah ruah, manis, dan wangi sekali! Tapi... tidak ada satu orang pun yang mau membelinya!
Keluarganya menolak. 'Waduh Pak, pisangnya manis banget, tapi kami sudah kenyang makan pisang tiap hari!' kata istrinya sambil tersenyum.
Pak Srinivas berkeliling ke tetangga dan teman-temannya. 'Tidak mau lagi, Pak Srinivas! Pohon pisang kami di halaman juga lagi berbuah lebat!' kata mereka sambil tertawa.
Pedagang pasar menggeleng: 'Di kota lagi banjir pisang!' Bahkan sapi-sapi peliharaannya melengos dan menolak memakannya! Aduh, gawat!
Kasihan sekali Pak Srinivas! Apa yang harus ia lakukan dengan bertumpuk-tumpuk pisang manis ini? Kalau dibiarkan, semuanya bisa membusuk sia-sia!
Aha! Pak Srinivas memutuskan pergi ke Pusat Pertanian di kota Doddooru untuk meminta saran. Pasti para ahli di sana punya ide cemerlang!
Beberapa hari kemudian, Pak Srinivas pulang sambil bersiul riang. Ia kembali berkebun dengan gembira, tapi anehnya... ia tidak lagi menawarkan pisang kepada siapa pun!
Semua orang di desa jadi sangat penasaran! 'Ke mana perginya pisang-pisang lebat Pak Srinivas?' bisik para tetangga penuh tanda tanya.

Suatu hari, tetangga Shivanna mengadakan upacara syukuran besar di desa. Sang pendeta berkata: 'Kita membutuhkan 108 buah pisang ranum!' Pak Shivanna panik dan berlari ke rumah Pak Srinivas: 'Tolong bantu aku! Aku butuh 108 pisang!'
Pak Srinivas tersenyum: 'Tentu, mulailah upacaranya, aku pasti datang!' Di tengah upacara, Pak Srinivas tiba membawa keranjang besar berisi 27 bungkusan rapi dari daun pisang hijau segar.

Tertulis di bungkusnya: 'Dodol Pisang Manis Istimewa Kebun Srinivas!' Tiap bungkus berisi sari 4 pisang matang, pas untuk 108 pisang! Seluruh warga tertawa gembira, bertepuk tangan, dan menikmati hidangan manis bersama-sama!
scenesEn: Sringeri Srinivas was having a very strange day. His farm was full of sweet, ripe bananas! But... nobody wanted to buy them!
Not his family. 'Oh, they are very sweet, but we have eaten bananas every day and we are completely full!' they said.
He offered them to his neighbours and friends. 'No thank you, Sringeri! Our banana trees in the garden are bursting with fruit too!' they said with a laugh.
Market traders shook their heads. And not even his cows wanted them! They turned their heads away and swished their tails. Oh dear!
Poor Sringeri Srinivas! What could he possibly do with so many bananas before they went bad?
He decided to seek help from the Farmer's Centre in Doddooru. Surely someone there would have a brilliant idea!
A few days later, he returned home beaming with joy. He went back to farming, but curiously, he stopped offering bananas to anyone!
Everyone in the village became very curious. 'Where on earth are all his bananas going?' they wondered in whispers.
One day, neighbour Shivanna held a big village ceremony. The priest needed 108 ripe bananas! Shivanna rushed to Sringeri: 'Please help me! I need 108 bananas!'
Sringeri Srinivas smiled: 'Start your ceremony, I will surely come!' Just then, in came Sringeri carrying a big bag with 27 neat packets wrapped in fresh banana leaves.

On each packet was written: 'High Quality Banana Halwa, S.S. Farms!' Each packet held the pulp of 4 bananas—totalling exactly 108 bananas! The whole village clapped, laughed, and enjoyed the delicious sweet treat together!

poc-kancil.en: The Clever Mouse Deer and Crocodiles
poc-kancil.summaryId: Di suatu pagi yang cerah, Sang Kancil yang lincah berdiri di tepi sungai. Perutnya berbunyi lapar melihat pohon rambutan yang lebat berbuah
poc-kancil.moralId: Gunakan Akal Sehat dan Kebaikan untuk Menyelesaikan Masalah! Kecerdikan dan akal sehat dapat membantu kita mengatasi rintangan yang tampak mustahil.
scenesId: Di suatu pagi yang cerah, Sang Kancil yang lincah berdiri di tepi sungai. Perutnya berbunyi lapar melihat pohon rambutan yang lebat berbuah manis di seberang sana.
Namun sungainya sangat lebar dan berarus deras! Kancil pun memanggil kawanan buaya, Hai Buaya, keluarlah! Raja Hutan menyuruhku menghitung jumlah kalian!
Para buaya pun berbaris rapi dari tepi ke tepi. Dengan tangkas, Kancil melompat ke punggung buaya satu per satu sambil berhitung riang, Satu, dua, tiga, empat!
Hup! Kancil berhasil sampai di seberang sungai dengan selamat. Terima kasih buaya, aku hanya ingin menyeberang! seru Kancil sambil menikmati buah manis yang lezat.

raja-gemuk-anjing-kurus.summaryId: Kisah Lucu Penuh Tawa Tentang Persahabatan & Kesehatan
raja-gemuk-anjing-kurus.summaryEn: A Charming Bedtime Tale of Friendship and Fitness
raja-gemuk-anjing-kurus.moralId: Pesan moral cerita ini: Rajin bergerak dan berolahraga membuat tubuh kita bugar, sehat, dan kuat! Bergerak setiap hari bersama sahabat itu sangat menyenangkan!
raja-gemuk-anjing-kurus.moralEn: The moral of the story: Staying active and exercising every day makes our bodies fit, healthy, and strong! Running and playing with a friend brings endless joy!
scenesId: Di sebuah istana yang megah, hiduplah seorang raja yang sangat gemuk.
Sang raja punya seekor sahabat kecil... seekor anjing yang sangat kurus!
Suatu pagi yang cerah, sang raja gemuk dan anjing kurusnya pergi berjalan-jalan santai di taman.
Tiba-tiba, si anjing kurus melihat seekor burung kecil yang cantik di atas ranting! Cip cip cip!
Guk guk! Si anjing kurus langsung lari kencang mengejar burung itu!
Waduh! Sang raja kaget bukan main! 'Tunggu aku!' teriak raja sambil berlari mengejar anjingnya!
Mereka lari dan lari! Menanjak bukit tinggi, menuruni lembah hijau, berhari-hari tanpa henti! Hosh... hosh... hosh!
Greb! Akhirnya, sang raja berhasil memeluk anjing kurusnya! Horeee!
Sekarang, coba lihat ke cermin! Sang raja gemuk sekarang menjadi langsing, sehat, dan bugar! Dan si anjing tersenyum gembira!
scenesEn: In a grand palace, there lived a very fat king.
The fat king had a little companion... a very thin dog!
One bright sunny morning, the fat king and his thin dog went for a leisurely walk in the park.
Suddenly, the thin dog spotted a lovely little bird perched on a branch! Chirp chirp chirp!
Woof woof! The thin dog bolted forward and ran as fast as lightning after the bird!
Oh no! The fat king was astonished! 'Wait for me!' yelled the king, running as fast as he could after his dog!
They ran and ran! Up steep hills, down rolling meadows, for days and days without stopping! Pant... puff... whew!
Catch! At last, the king scooped up and hugged his beloved dog! Hooray!
Now, take a look in the mirror! The fat king is now fit, healthy, and trim! And both of them are smiling with joy!

sringeri-srinivas-belajar-tertawa.summaryId: Komedi Jenaka Pak Petani Pisang & Monyet Usil di Sringeri
sringeri-srinivas-belajar-tertawa.summaryEn: A Joyful Comedy of a Grumpy Farmer and One Cheeky Monkey
sringeri-srinivas-belajar-tertawa.moralId: Pesan moral cerita ini: Tawa Tulus Mampu Mencairkan Hari Terberat!. Saat segala hal terasa serba salah, belajarlah menertawakan kejadian lucu dengan hati lapang.
sringeri-srinivas-belajar-tertawa.moralEn: The moral of the story: A Good Laugh Brightens Any Gloomy Day!. Even on grumpy mornings, seeing the funny side turns frowns into joyful laughter!
scenesId: Sringeri Srinivas adalah seorang petani yang baik. Ia menanam pisang terbaik, yang menghasilkan halwa pisang terlezat.
Tetapi ia juga memiliki cemberut paling menyeramkan di dunia. Saat marah, dahinya berkerut dalam, hidungnya memerah, dan matanya menajam.
Saat Sringeri Srinivas cemberut, semua orang lari menjauh. Istri, anak-anak, teman-temannya, sapi, anjing, bahkan burung gagak di ladang pun terbang menjauh.
Dan Sringeri Srinivas sering sekali cemberut. Saat tanamannya tidak tumbuh subur, saat tukang cukur sibuk, atau saat televisi rusak.
Suatu hari, Sringeri Srinivas pergi ke ladangnya untuk melihat panen pisangnya. Suasana hatinya sedang buruk, entah mengapa.
Ia berjalan cepat ke pohon pisangnya yang paling besar. Ada tandan-tandan pisang yang indah. Cemberutnya pun berubah menjadi senyuman kecil.
Tiba-tiba, sekelompok monyet berayun dari pohon terdekat. Yang paling besar langsung melompat tepat ke pohon pisang kebanggaan Sringeri Srinivas.
Hal itu membuatnya cemberut lagi! Cemberutnya makin lama makin besar, menjadi cemberut terbesarnya dari kepala hingga ujung kaki.
Si monyet terkejut melihat cemberut seperti itu. Ia menjatuhkan pisangnya, lalu melompat cepat dari satu pohon ke pohon lain hingga jauh dan aman.
Sringeri Srinivas mengejar monyet itu karena ingin memberinya pelajaran.
Di tengah jalan, ia terpeleset kulit pisang! Swussh, ia jatuh dan sandalnya tersangkut di lumpur.
Sringeri Srinivas duduk dan mencoba mengejar lagi. Swussh! Ia terpeleset lagi, kali ini jatuh tertelungkup.
Ia berhasil duduk kembali dengan mulut penuh daun, lumpur, dan ranting. Saat menengadah, monyet-monyet sudah pergi.
Sringeri Srinivas melihat dirinya sendiri. Bajunya kecokelatan, tangannya kotor, dan kakinya berlumuran tanah.
Tiba-tiba ia sadar betapa lucunya penampilannya di atas tumpukan daun, lumpur, dan pisang. Ia pun mulai tertawa pelan, hihi, lalu semakin keras, haha!
Semakin ia tertawa, semakin ia ingin terus tertawa! Tawanya membahana HA HA HA hingga ia memegangi perut dan bergulingan di lumpur sambil berair mata.
Tawanya begitu merdu dan riang hingga burung-burung datang mendengarkan, monyet-monyet kembali, anak-anak berdatangan, dan seluruh keluarganya ikut keluar.
Semua orang dan hewan pun ikut tertawa! Burung berkicau, gagak berkaok, anak-anak terkikik, tukang cukur dan penjahit tersenyum lebar, bahkan harimau di gua ikut tersenyum.
Semua tampak begitu bahagia, dan Sringeri Srinivas pun merasa bahagia. Ia mengulurkan tangan kepada anak-anaknya dan mengajak pulang. Kini ia punya tawa terbesar di kota!
scenesEn: Sringeri Srinivas was a good farmer. He grew the best bananas, which made the best banana halwa.
But he also had the scariest frown in the world. When he was angry, his forehead became full of deep lines. His nose became red. His eyes became very sharp.

When Sringeri Srinivas frowned, everyone ran away from him. His wife, his children and his friends tried to hide. His cows and his dogs ran away. Even the crows in the field flew away when Sringeri Srinivas frowned.
And Sringeri Srinivas frowned often. When his crops were not growing well. When his barber had no time to cut his hair. When the TV did not work. And so on. And on.
One day, Sringeri Srinivas went into his field to look at his banana harvest. He was in a bad mood. No one knew why.
He walked quickly to his biggest banana plant. There were big bunches of lovely fruit. Soon, he would begin to make his famous banana halwa. His frown changed to a small smile.
Just then, a troop of monkeys came swinging from a tree nearby. The biggest one, with a fiery red bottom, jumped exactly onto the plant that Sringeri Srinivas was looking at proudly.
This made him frown again. His frown grew and grew. It was his biggest frown ever. It began from his head and spread right to his toes.

The monkey, with his own nasty temper, was surprised. He had never seen a frown like that. He dropped a half-peeled banana on the ground, then he dropped a few more. Quickly, he jumped to the next plant and then the next. Soon, he was far away and safe from the frown.
Sringeri Srinivas saw the monkey leap from plant to plant. He chased the monkey. He wanted to teach the monkey a lesson.
On the way, he slipped on a banana peel. Swoosh, he went down, and his chappals got stuck in the mud.
Sringeri Srinivas sat up and tried to chase the monkey again. Swoosh! He slipped again. This time, he fell with his face down.
Somehow, he managed to sit up again, his mouth full of leaves and mud and twigs. When he looked up, the monkeys had gone.
Sringeri Srinivas looked down at himself. His nice shirt was brown. His hands were dirty and scratched. He could not even find his own legs. They were all mixed up in the soil.

Suddenly, he realised that he looked very funny. Sringeri Srinivas, the famous farmer. He was now sitting all by himself on a pile of leaves, mud and bananas. It was all very funny. And Sringeri Srinivas began to laugh. It was a little laugh at first. Hee Hee. Then it became bigger. Ha Ha!

The more he laughed, the more Sringeri Srinivas wanted to laugh. The laugh grew bigger. HA HA HA. And bigger! Soon, he was clutching his stomach, and rolling on the mud. HA HA HA HAAAA! Tears were rolling out of his eyes.

The laugh was so musical that the birds nearby came to listen. The laugh was so loud that the monkeys came back. The laugh was so funny that many kids came along. The laugh was so new that his whole family came out to hear it, too.

Sringeri Srinivas laughed so much that everyone else began to laugh as well. The birds twittered. The crows cawed. The monkeys chattered. The kids began to giggle. The banana plants began to sway. The barber in the shop grinned. The tailor began to chortle. Even the tiger sleeping far away in his cave smiled into his whiskers.

Suddenly, Sringeri Srinivas finished laughing. Everything and everyone around him looked so happy. He felt happy too. "Come on, let's go home," he said, holding his hands out to his children. Sringeri Srinivas still frowns sometimes. But now, he also likes to laugh. And he has the biggest laugh in town.

terlalu-banyak-suara.summaryId: Kisah Jenaka Menemukan Ketenangan dengan Cara Cerdas & Penuh Tawa
terlalu-banyak-suara.summaryEn: A Hilarious Bedtime Tale of Finding Peace & Clever Solutions
terlalu-banyak-suara.moralId: Pesan moral cerita ini: Di dunia yang penuh kebisingan dan kesibukan, kita selalu bisa menemukan ketenangan jika bersikap tenang dan mencari solusi cerdas. Jangan biarkan kekesalan merusak hubungan kita dengan orang-orang tercinta di sekitar kita!
terlalu-banyak-suara.moralEn: The moral of the story: In a world full of noise and hurry, we can always find peace by staying calm and thinking creatively. Never let frustration hurt our relationships with the loved ones around us!
scenesId: Suatu hari, Sringeri Srinivas si petani berambut panjang berangkat bersama sapi-sapi terbaiknya menuju pekan ternak. Mereka harus berjalan menyusuri jalan raya nasional baru yang dibangun di dekat desanya.

Jalan raya besar itu sangat ramai dengan mobil dan truk. Setiap pengemudi membunyikan klakson dengan sangat kencang. Paoon! Ponn! Paaa! Sapi-sapi itu sama sekali tidak suka kebisingan ini. Mereka berbalik dan kabur pulang ke rumah!

Srinivas melambaikan tangannya meminta para pengemudi berhenti. Tetapi melihatnya, mereka malah membunyikan klakson lebih keras lagi! Suara bising itu masuk tepat ke dalam kepalanya dan tertahan di sana. Srinivas terpaksa pulang ke kandang bersama sapi-sapinya.

Tetapi suara bising itu tidak mau pergi dari kepalanya! Paoon! Ponn! Paaa! Bunyi itu terus berputar seperti kelompok musik yang kacau. Suara-suara lain di sekitarnya pun ikut terdengar bising. Bunyi yang biasa ia dengar setiap hari mendadak terasa teramat nyaring.

Suara katak terdengar memekakkan telinga. Derik jangkrik terasa teramat keras. Srinivas bahkan ingin burung hantu diusir pergi! Ia kesal pada burung koyal yang berkicau nyaring pukul empat pagi, ayam jantan yang berkokok, dan auman harimau di kejauhan!

Kasihan Sringeri Srinivas. Telinganya terasa perih seperti luka baru. Ia berteriak pada anak-anak yang berbicara terlalu keras. Ia memelototi istrinya, Parvatamma, saat panci presto berbunyi mendesis-desis di dapur!

Sringeri Srinivas hanya mendambakan ketenangan. Semua warga desa berusaha membantu. Parvatamma berhenti mengomeli anak-anak. Anak-anak bermain kriket dengan bola yang sangat lembut dan tanpa suara. Sapi-sapi berhenti melenguh, dan burung hantu terbang ke desa lain.

Namun Srinivas masih belum bahagia. Ia bahkan bisa mendengar suara orang-orang yang bersusah payah untuk diam! 'Aku akan pergi dari tempat berisik ini!' serunya suatu pagi. Parvatamma memohon agar ia tidak pergi, tetapi Srinivas tetap melangkah meninggalkan desanya.

Ia tiba di sebuah kota yang tak kalah bisingnya. Tiba-tiba seorang pemuda lewat dengan kabel menggantung di telinganya. Ada bunyi musik ting dang ting dang. Pemuda itu terlihat sangat santai dan bahagia, sama sekali tidak terganggu oleh klakson truk di sampingnya!

'Benda apa ini?' tanya Srinivas. 'Ini headphone-ku. Cobalah!' kata pemuda itu. Musik merdu terdengar! Tidak ada bunyi klakson! 'Aha! Inilah yang kubutuhkan!' seru Srinivas. Ia langsung membeli sepasang headphone terbaik dan pulang ke desa dengan senyum lebar.

Kini, saat Srinivas merasa terganggu oleh suara mobil atau katak, ia cukup memasang headphonenya dan menikmati musik damai. Di desa, sapi-sapi kembali melenguh riang, dan burung-burung berkicau gembira. Namun mobil di jalan raya masih berisik. Srinivas menatap sapi-sapinya... Mungkinkah sapi-sapi itu juga butuh headphone?
scenesEn: One day, Sringeri Srinivas, the farmer, set out with his best cows to the cattle fair. He had to walk along the new national highway that had come up near his village.
That big road had many cars and trucks. Every driver seemed to be honking loudly. Paoon! Ponn! Paaa! The cows did not like the noise at all. They decided to go back home.

He waved his hands at the drivers to stop the noise. This did not help. Seeing him, they just honked louder! The noise of the horns went straight into his head, and it stayed there. He went back home with his cows.

But the noise simply would not go away from his head. Paoon! Ponn! Paaa! It kept on playing like a band of untrained musicians. Other noises around him soon joined in. Even the sounds he heard daily suddenly became too loud for Sringeri Srinivas.

The ribbit ribbit of the frogs was noisy. The cicadas and their kirkk kirkk were too loud. Sringeri Srinivas wanted the hooting owls to be sent away. He was angry at the koyals for screeching loudly at four in the morning, and the roosters, and that tiger's roar!

Poor Sringeri Srinivas. His ears had become raw, like a fresh wound. He shouted at the children if they talked loudly. He glared at his wife Parvatamma when the pressure cooker whistled and whistled in the kitchen!

Sringeri Srinivas only wanted silence. Everyone tried to help. Parvatamma stopped scolding the children. The children played cricket quietly with a very soft ball. The cows did not moo anymore, and the owls moved away to another village.

Yet Sringeri Srinivas was not happy. He could hear the noise of everyone trying to be silent! 'I will go away from this place,' he declared one morning. Parvatamma asked where he would find silence, but Srinivas simply walked away from his village.

Soon, he came close to a new town. A young man passed by with wires dangling from his ears. A happy ting dang ting dang sound played. The young man looked relaxed and cheerful, not even noticing the loud trucks blaring horns nearby!

'What is this?' he asked. 'These are my headphones. Try them on,' the young man said. Music! Ting dang ting dang! No horns! 'Aha! This is just what I need!' said Srinivas. He bought the best headphones, and returned to his village with a wide smile.

Now, when Srinivas gets bothered by cars or noisy frogs, he puts on his headphones and listens to peaceful music. In the village, cows are mooing and birds are singing happily again. But on the highway, cars are still noisy. Sringeri Srinivas looks at his cows... Will they want headphones too?

topsy-turvy-serba-terbalik.summaryId: Kisah Jenaka Saat Kamar Menjadi Ajaib dan Lucu
topsy-turvy-serba-terbalik.summaryEn: A Hilarious Bedtime Tale of an Upside Down Magic Day
topsy-turvy-serba-terbalik.moralId: Pesan moral cerita ini: Tetap Tenang Saat Mengalami Hal Tak Terduga!. Ketika keadaan menjadi kacau atau tidak seperti biasanya, jangan langsung panik atau menangis. Tetaplah tersenyum dan tenang, karena setiap masalah selalu ada jalan keluarnya!
topsy-turvy-serba-terbalik.moralEn: The moral of the story: Stay Calm When Things Turn Upside Down!. When unexpected chaos happens or things feel upside down, don't panic or cry. Stay calm with a smile, because every funny mess always has a solution!
scenesId: Entah mengapa, pagi ini aku bangun sangat pagi. Dan tak disangka, hari baru yang sungguh aneh telah menantiku!
Sama sekali tak ada yang beres di dalam ruangan. Dan tiba-tiba, ada suara berteriak keras ke arahku!
Kasur tidur kami memanjat naik ke dinding tinggi! Dan jam dinding kecilku mendadak tumbuh menjadi sangat jangkung!
Payung kami berputar-putar kencang tanpa henti! Topi merah biruku terus berbunyi klik-klak klik-klak sendiri!
Aduh, apa yang sedang terjadi dengan kamar kecil kami? Rasanya aku mau pingsan sekarang juga!
Kipas angin di langit-langit berubah menjadi gurita! Boneka adikku sedang lahap menyantap nasi dan lauknya!
Kucing kami duduk bersantai di kursi Ayah. Dan lihatlah ke televisi! Seekor tikus kecil sedang membacakan berita!
Saat bercermin... Aaaah! Tinggiku mendadak menjadi dua meter lebih! Aku hampir menangis kencang rasanya!
Tetapi tiba-tiba, datanglah seorang pesulap ajaib. 'Maaf! Maafkan aku!' katanya ramah, 'Biar kubantu bereskan semuanya!'
'Ya, benar! Akulah yang membuat kekacauan kecil ini. Sungguh tidak sengaja, aku mengaku salah!'
'Abrakadabra cin-cin-cu! Wahai kamar ajaib, kembalilah rapi seperti semula, satu, dua, tiga!' Cling! Semua benda pun kembali ke tempatnya.
scenesEn: I do not know why I woke up very early today. Soon I saw that it was a strange new day!
Nothing at all was as it really should be. And I could hear someone shouting loudly at me!
Our cot had climbed right up the wall. And my little clock had grown very tall!
Our umbrella was twirling madly round and round. My red and blue cap was making a clicking sound!
What on earth has happened to our little room? I fear I am going to faint very soon!
The fan has turned into a big octopus. My sister's doll is eating dal and rice without a fuss.
Our cat is sitting up in Papa's chair. And look! A mouse is reading the news on the air!
In the mirror - Aah! See! I am seven feet high! I know I am going to loudly cry!
But now look! Here comes a magic man. "Sorry! Sorry!" he says, "I will do what I can!"
"Yes, yes! It was I who made this little mess. It was not so nice of me, I do confess!"
"So Abra-ca-da-dabra chin chin choo! Room! Get back in order - one - three - two!"
